description: Get one of the signed-in person's collections: its items in order with notes, its revision, and a ready-to-copy credit block. Use it when someone wants to see what a collection holds, or before editing one, to read its revision and item track ids. Not for credits as text, markdown or CSV; use export_collection_credits for those. Returns the collection with items and credits. Read-only; needs a signed-in account; a collection of another account returns not_found. Example: {"id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}.

id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

name: get_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits.description: The credits block for the collection as it stands.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Get a collection
